observations: Starting at one, first update produced 1.5 and one matching significant digit.
Automatic iteration displayed matching counts one, three, six, twelve, then fifteen; fourth update reached twelve digits and sixth did not change.
Screenshot showed bold matching prefixes, growing digit bars, and a dynamically zoomed number line with g, 2/g and their average.
History slider returned to update zero without losing completed evidence; reveal explained error cancellation, approximate error squaring and floating-point limit.
